environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API) with CloudFront distribution. CloudFront has a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) attached which corresponds to the 'SecurityHeadersPolicy' managed policy. This policy injects a default-src 'self' directive via the content-security-policy response header field with override enabled. Additionally, the API Gateway has a Gateway Response configured for DEFAULT_4XX and DEFAULT_5XX that includes the same CSP header. The CloudFront behavior has origin-request policy set to AllViewerExceptHostHeader and the cache policy uses CachingOptimized with TTL min=1s. The Lambda function's response headers are merged with CloudFront's response header policy where CloudFront policy takes precedence due to 'override: true' on the CSP header configuration.
